_comment: Inner object of the { data: ... } envelope the diagnostics route returns (builder src/app/api/olympus/voice/diagnostics/route.ts, action=diagnose_setup). dids_without_e911 counts is_active DIDs with a null e911_address_id that are NOT toll-free (the route leaves toll-free out and reports it as toll_free_dids_exempt_from_e911), so it is 1 here (did_5) and it cannot see did_3, whose address exists but is still pending verification. The pinned blocking_issues string is the route's own template; the 'no verified E911 addresses' blocker stays off because one address is verified. verified_e911_addresses counts voice_e911_addresses rows with verified_at NOT NULL.

blocking_issues: 1 active DID(s) have no E911 address — calls may not connect emergency services.
